title: Tokka-Bench：跨100种自然语言与20种编程语言的Tokenizer评估框架
summary: Tokka-Bench是一个开源框架，通过字节每token、唯一token覆盖率、子词生育率、词切分率和词表组成五项指标，评估100种自然语言和20种编程语言的分词器。对比七种BPE分词器发现，词表分配策略比词表规模更重要，且编程语言效率已趋同。
summary_en: Tokka-Bench is an open-source framework evaluating tokenizers on five metrics—bytes per token, unique token coverage, subword fertility, word-split rate, and vocabulary composition—across 100 natural languages and 20 programming languages. Comparing seven BPE tokenizers reveals vocabulary allocation strategy matters more than raw size, and programming-language efficiency has converged.
